capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: KBB 2027 EX90 specs page lists the same packs as 2026 (92 kWh single, 106 kWh twin/performance); nominal figure per Volvo spec pages (heise gives usable). Other 2027 values carried over from 2026.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: heise: 2026 EX90 102 kWh usable for the large pack, up to 350 kW. 2027: carry-over from 2026 (KBB 2027 page lists the same packs; The Charge Port lists EX90 2025-2027 together).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: CATL cells on the 2026 800 V packs too (92/106 kWh); the 2025 pack is NMC (Motor1); no source names the 800 V chemistry and nothing shows a change. InsideEVs (EX60) says Volvo packs are high-nickel.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs, heise, Electrifying: 2026 EX90 moves to an 800 V architecture. 2027: carry-over from 2026 (KBB 2027 page lists the same packs; The Charge Port lists EX90 2025-2027 together).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Volvo US EX90 support article, read only as a search excerpt (volvocars.com 403): preconditioning starts automatically when a DC fast charger is the navigation destination and can also be started manually in the charging view. Applied to every EX90 year; nothing shows a change after the 800 V update.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: heise: peak 350 kW for the 102 kWh pack (Electrifying: 350 kW top). 2027: carry-over from 2026 (KBB 2027 page lists the same packs; The Charge Port lists EX90 2025-2027 together).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the 2025 EX90 onboard charger is 11 kW (Motor1); no 2026-27 page states AC and nothing shows an onboard-charger change with the 800 V update (the EX60 has 19.2 kW, but KBB does not tie that to the EX90).

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: heise: 10-80% about 22 minutes under ideal conditions. 2027: carry-over from 2026 (KBB 2027 page lists the same packs; The Charge Port lists EX90 2025-2027 together).
